hello.text: Come in, come in. There is soup, and there are beds, and you look as if you want both. Sorry. I always say that. It's always true, though, isn't it?

choices.text: I would like a bed here.

bread.text: Oh, fine, fine. Only I count the bread twice now, since the assessor came. He's a nice man, he never takes a crumb, but I count it anyway. Twice. Sometimes three times. Sorry. Soup?
